caseNameFull: Bonet, Treasurer v. Texas Company (P. R.) Inc.
attorneys: Messrs. William Cattron Rigby and Nathan R. Margold for petitioner. Mr. Thomas Kirby Schmuck for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certi-orari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the First Circuit, granted.

Mr. Justice Stone took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
